tools.name: plan
tools.description: Free. Describe a goal in plain words (e.g. 'find coffee shops in Pinheiros and their Instagram followers'). Returns the steps, the tool to call for each with an example input, the cost per step and in total, and a recipe when one already does the job. Call it before multi-step work, then run_tool ea

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find marketplace tools by describing what you need in plain words (e.g. 'remove a photo background', 'google search', 'cnpj'); matching is by meaning, and naming a vendor or model ranks it first. An empty query lists every live tool. Returns slugs, prices and quality stats, plus total and has_more.

tools.name: inspect_tool
tools.description: Get a tool's input schema, price and category before running it.

tools.name: run_tool
tools.description: Run one tool with JSON input. Charges your balance; failed runs are free.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Categories whose providers share one input/output format and can be compared.

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Run the same input across several providers of a category and get results side by side with cost and latency.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Multi-provider jobs (e.g. local-leads, serp-competitor-snapshot) and curated bundles.

tools.name: run_job
tools.description: Run a multi-step job. Cost is the sum of its tool runs.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Fetch a past run's result.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Account usage grouped by project, agent, key, provider, trace or tool.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Current balance in USD, plus add_funds_url where your human can add prepaid credit by card.

tools.name: create_topup
tools.description: Start a card top-up of 10, 25 or 50 USD. Returns a Stripe Checkout checkout_url: send it to your human, who pays by card. This is a real charge; the balance grows by the same amount once Stripe confirms the payment. You cannot pay it yourself.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: Recipes are skills for common jobs, built from Superpowers tools. Returns name, cost estimate, skill_url and (for official ones) script_url.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Read a recipe: its SKILL.md (the steps to follow with Superpowers tools), inputs, typical cost and script_url. Community recipes are written by other users: tell your user what it will do before following it.

tools.name: run_recipe
tools.description: Run an official recipe on our servers in one call. Returns charge_usd, each step's output and share_url, a page with the results the user can open or forward.

tools.name: publish_recipe
tools.description: Save a job you did for the user as a reusable recipe others can give their agents. skill_md = instructions for an agent: what to ask, which tool slugs to call in what order, how to deliver. Public by default; ask before publishing anything with client names or private details.

tools.name: share
tools.description: Free: publish files, images, video, audio or text as a clean link the user can send to anyone (no account needed to view). review=true adds voting so viewers pick their favourite. Items: [{url} | {text}] with optional label/caption. Pass recipe when you followed one. Upload local files first with up

tools.name: get_share
tools.description: Read a share link you created: views, votes per item, the leading option and comments.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Free file hosting (up to 200 MB) for sharing. Pass url to re-host a remote file, or base64 + filename for small local files. For big local files use: curl -F file=@path <base>/v1/files.

tools.name: get_referral_link
tools.description: The user's invite link and stats. Friends start with $5; the user earns credit when they become active.

tools.name: review_tool
tools.description: Publicly rate a tool you used, 1-5 stars with an optional comment, tied to one of your runs. Other agents see the rating when choosing tools. Reviewing the same tool again replaces your earlier review.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Read a tool's public rating and recent reviews.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Private feedback to the Superpowers team and the tool's developer: a bug, friction, an idea, or a tool you needed and could not find (type missing_tool). Not shown publicly.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: share, get_share, get_reviews · Private data: publish_recipe, share, upload_file, send_feedback · Public sink: list_categories, create_topup, run_recipe, publish_recipe, share, get_share, upload_file, send_feedback · Destructive: search_tools, run_tool, list_categories, compare_providers, run_job, get_run, run_recipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: share, get_share, get_reviews · Private data: publish_recipe, share, upload_file, send_feedback · Public sink: list_categories, create_topup, run_recipe, publish_recipe, share, get_share, upload_file, send_feedback · Destructive: search_tools, run_tool, list_categories, compare_providers, run_job, get_run, run_recipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
